title: Trinity Cap for Petri V2
description:
This cap reflects not only high quality and aesthetic, but functionality for the cloud chaser.

This cap offers the same properties as the regular cap with a more generous airflow and much easier draw for a smooth and cloudy experience. The glass bell cap also provides incredible and full flavour out of your RDA.
